item.title: US intelligence warns of advanced Iranian plots to kill American officials abroad, prompting diplomatic pullback
item.description: The United States intelligence community has warned that Iranian plots to target US personnel abroad have reached “advanced stages,” prompting the State Department to reduce diplomatic staff and evacuate family members from multiple posts across the Middle East, according to a classified memo and…

item.title: Federal Reserve set to meet Wednesday, expected to hold rates but signal December hike
item.description: The Federal Reserve is expected to hold its benchmark interest rate steady when it concludes a two-day policy meeting on Wednesday, but is likely to signal that a rate hike remains possible at its December meeting. item.title: Ebola spreads to Kenya and Nigeria as second patient dies in Kenya
item.description: Kenya has recorded its second death from Ebola, a 65-year-old woman who was a close family member of the country's first victim, as the virus also reaches Nigeria with a confirmed imported case.
